entities.name: Ulugh Beg and Timurid Renaissance
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Ulugh Beg and Timurid Renaissance, a transformative movement in Uzbekistan (1405–1449). Emerged from Timur defeats the Ottoman Sultan Bayezid I at the Battle of Ankara and Bibi-Khanym Mosque constructed — the largest mosque in Central Asia at its time. Catalyzed Mughal Empire and Babur and Timurid Decline.
